Account background: spun out of a BPO automation studio; heavy Zendesk + internal CRM usage. Primary buyer: VP Support (Claire Reynolds) + Head of CS Ops (Tom Iqbal).

Key objectives: reduce average handle time by 20%, automate triage tags for 60% of inbound tickets, produce consistent agent-facing summaries for email threads, and ensure tooling survives 3x daily peak bursts during promotions. Interested in both hosted for quick time-to-value and Dedicated/VPC for PII-sensitive flows.

What we've heard on calls: 
- "We need 1-2 sentence TL;DR + three suggested macros for each ticket." - Claire
- Concerned about noisy auto-tags (false positives) causing routing mistakes. want precision > 85% for top-10 tags.
- Must integrate with Zendesk triggers/macros and Freshdesk workflows; legal requires retention controls and ability to purge PII on request.

POC focus: ingest 30k historical tickets + email threads, evaluate offline summarization quality vs human baseline, measure auto-tag precision/recall by tag group, run synthetic spike with 5k concurrent short messages to evaluate latency and fallbacks.

Integration notes: will use Zendesk OAuth app for initial POC, need SDK example of ticket-create webhook -> Redwood API -> macro suggestions payload. SE asked for sample app to demo function-calling (tool-calls) to trigger internal macros.

Commercial posture: mid-size ARR target, willing to do 6-12 month pilot with SLA uplift if Dedicated reserved capacity required. Pricing sensitivity around token-based charges during spikes.

Open items: share security FAQ + certs (done 2024-12-02), finalize IdP metadata for SSO, confirm whether retention policy can be scoped per workspace in Dedicated deployment.
